annotations.title: Get cited page text (uses a key credit)

description: Fetch a public URL and return its cited, paragraph-addressable text with integrity hashes and a receipt. Uses one credit from a ProofFetch key, and only when extraction succeeds. Needs the key sent as the MCP request header Authorization: Bearer <key>: a free key holds 25 extractions (no card, POST /v1/keys/free or the ProofFetch home page); a paid key holds 500 for $5.00 (sold on the ProofFetch home page). Example: {"url":"https://example.com/"}.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. The same value on a retry within 7 days returns the stored result without using a second credit; a call without one is a new purchase.

maxChars.description: Maximum normalized characters to extract. Free preflight returns metadata plus a preview of about the first 1,000 characters.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) document URL. No credentials, private networks, authenticated pages or browser rendering.
